name: Ineligibility Notification
subject: [DSTA] Update on Your Internship Application — {{programme_name}}
body:
Dear {{first_name}},

Thank you for applying to the DSTA {{programme_name}} internship programme.

After careful review, we regret to inform you that your application does not meet the eligibility requirements for this programme. As a result, we are unable to proceed with your application at this time.

We appreciate the time and effort you put into your application and encourage you to look out for future internship opportunities with DSTA.

Should you have any queries, please do not hesitate to contact us at internship@dsta.gov.sg.

We wish you all the best in your academic journey.

Warm regards,
Internship Office
Defence Science and Technology Agency (DSTA)
internship@dsta.gov.sg

name: Pre-Interview Rejection
subject: [DSTA] Update on Your Internship Application — {{programme_name}}
body:
Dear {{first_name}},

Thank you for your interest in the DSTA {{programme_name}} internship programme and for taking the time to submit your application.

After careful consideration, we regret to inform you that we are unable to offer you a placement for this intake. The selection process was highly competitive and we received a large number of strong applications.

We appreciate your interest in DSTA and encourage you to apply again in future cycles. Please continue to look out for internship opportunities on our website.

Thank you once again for your application, and we wish you every success in your future endeavours.

Warm regards,
Internship Office
Defence Science and Technology Agency (DSTA)
internship@dsta.gov.sg

name: Post-Interview Rejection
subject: [DSTA] Update on Your Internship Application — {{programme_name}}
body:
Dear {{first_name}},

Thank you for attending the interview for the DSTA {{programme_name}} internship programme. We appreciate the time and effort you invested in the process.

After careful deliberation, we regret to inform you that we are unable to offer you a placement for this intake. This was a difficult decision given the high calibre of candidates we interviewed.

We encourage you to continue developing your skills and to apply again in future internship cycles. Please look out for upcoming opportunities on our website.

We wish you every success in your studies and future career.

Warm regards,
Internship Office
Defence Science and Technology Agency (DSTA)
internship@dsta.gov.sg
